project_title: Reuters Corporate Intelligence Terminal - Australia Wire
archetype: Financial Newsroom Meets Modern Game Show

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

hierarchy.ticker_header: font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-amber-500 font-bold
hierarchy.hero_title: font-serif text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight

sticky_dashboard.description: Top sticky live wire ticker broadcast bar with Reuters branding, total live score counter (e.g. 28/40), real-time stopwatch timer, high-precision progress percentage gauge, theme switcher, leaderboard drawer trigger, and AI question regenerator button.
sticky_dashboard.blur: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/80 dark:bg-slate-950/85 light:bg-white/90 border-b border-slate-800

grid_structure.cols: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-5 sm:gap-6
grid_structure.filtering: Company tabs bar (ALL, ANZ, Star, Santos, Rio Tinto, WiseTech) + Category/Difficulty tags + Search filter input + Answer status filter (All, Answered, Unanswered, Incorrect, Correct)

question_card.base_style: p-5 border flex flex-col justify-between transition-all duration-200 relative overflow-hidden shadow-sm hover:shadow-md

motion_and_interactions.option_select_feedback: Instant visual transition: option card flashes emerald or crimson with sub-second spring scale transition
motion_and_interactions.submit_action: Locks all radio/option inputs, triggers performance analysis calculate animation, opens full screen breakdown modal with score accolades
motion_and_interactions.modal_transitions: Framer motion scale-in with background glass blur backdrop

image_urls.description: Stock market trading terminal dark screen

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a complete full-stack dynamic solution: React JS frontend and FastAPI backend.

Ensure all 40 questions are fully structured across the 5 target companies (ANZ, The Star, Santos, Rio Tinto, WiseTech Global) with realistic, high-stakes financial intelligence scenarios (compliance, mergers, balance sheet figures, board movements, ESG risks, regulatory investigations).
Provide instant green/red option feedback when answering each question, with explanations for why an answer is correct.
Maintain live score (e.g., 28/40), stopwatch timer, and animated progress bar on the sticky header.
Include a dynamic AI question generator endpoint `/api/regenerate-questions` in FastAPI that generates fresh dynamic MCQs using predefined financial templates/LLM, updating the quiz grid.
Store quiz attempts and leaderboard entries in backend database/JSON file, accessible via `/api/leaderboard` GET and POST endpoints.
Ensure strict adherence to all `data-testid` requirements for robust automated test coverage.
Implement light/dark mode seamlessly using class-based or attribute-based Tailwind theme toggle.
